description: Status of the latest ownership transfer for a site (none, pending, accepted, declined, cancelled or expired), who it went to, the access the old owner keeps, expiry, and the last audit lines. Read-only: start, cancel or resend in Site settings. Site owner only. Same as GET /api/v1/sites/:id/transfer. Requires a paid plan (Starter or Growth); Hobby callers receive an upgrade message.

site_id.description: Site UUID, as returned by list_sites or add_website.
